vocab_words.example: The manager sent a memorandum about the new dress code.
We need to order more stationery for the office.
The filing system was reorganized last month.
Her itinerary includes three cities in five days.
The board decided to postpone the annual meeting.
Each attendee received a printed handout.
The team reached a consensus on the new schedule.
Could you take the minutes of today's meeting?
The manager will brief the staff at 9 a.m.

vocab_words.meaning: điều phối, tạo điều kiện thuận lợi
vocab_words.example: She was asked to facilitate the discussion.

items.question: It is essential that all staff ___ the new safety guidelines.
items.explanation: Câu giả định sau "it is essential that" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.question: ___ the delay, the project was completed under budget.
items.explanation: "Despite" + cụm danh từ, không phải mệnh đề đầy đủ như "although".

items.question: Our supplier can deliver the goods ___ two business days.
items.explanation: "Within" dùng để chỉ khoảng thời gian giới hạn (trong vòng).

items.question: The training session was ___ informative that attendees asked for a follow-up.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "so + adj + that" diễn tả kết quả.

items.question: The new policy will take effect ___ the beginning of next month.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "at the beginning of" dùng giới từ "at".

items.question: By the time the CEO arrives, the presentation ___ already finished.
items.explanation: Thì tương lai hoàn thành "will have + V3" diễn tả hành động hoàn tất trước một mốc trong tương lai.

items.question: Customers can track their orders ___ our new mobile application.
items.explanation: "Through" nghĩa là thông qua, bằng phương tiện gì.

items.question: ___ the budget cuts, the department managed to complete the project on time.
items.explanation: "Despite" theo sau là cụm danh từ (the budget cuts), không phải mệnh đề đầy đủ.

items.question: The board members ___ discussing the proposal when the fire alarm went off.
items.explanation: Thì quá khứ tiếp diễn diễn tả hành động đang xảy ra thì bị gián đoạn.

items.question: The HR department is responsible for ___ new employees.
items.explanation: Sau giới từ "for" cần V-ing (danh động từ).
